instruction: Turn on two-finger scrolling for the touchpad in touchpad settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling two-finger scrolling for touchpad. The config sets it to false initially, and the task is to set it to true. Evaluator verifies the setting returns 'true' (newline included).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts two-finger scrolling state using gsettings command
Metric exact_match is appropriate for boolean string comparison
Expected value 'true\n' correctly includes newline from gsettings output
Data flow is correct: command execution → string output → exact comparison
Complete coverage: single requirement (enable two-finger scrolling) is fully verified
State accessibility is good: gsettings values persist and can be read without UI being open
Expected value is semantically correct for gsettings output format
No postconfig needed: system setting verification doesn't require UI state
